bio.text: Diane Blair-Sherlock is a Democratic member of the Illinois House of Representatives for the 46th District, based in Villa Park.

According to the Illinois House Democrats biography, Blair-Sherlock holds an Associate in Arts degree from the College of DuPage, a B.A. in political science from Northern Illinois University and a J.D. from John Marshall Law School.
The biography says Blair-Sherlock is a private practice attorney and lives in Villa Park.
